tasks.title: The test gate gets back at least 10 seconds of headroom so the heavy-ship phase fits under its time ceiling
tasks.description: Gate room before any Phase 10 code lands (plan §2.15). GUT was about 225 s at the Phase 9 close against the 240 s ceiling; this phase needs about 20 s. Profile with scripts/gate-time.sh (15 slowest files), then recover time only by the tests/README.md rules: real-physics rows on the 8x clock, replays computed once and shared (before_all / memo keyed by inputs), per-tick bookkeeping no assertion reads dropped, or a production speed-up that is bit-identical (the Phase 8 t1 FighterBrain.tick precedent). Never lower a tick count, duration, sample count or start grid, widen a bound or remove an assertion. Record before / after and the Phase 10 per-task allotments in tests/README.md -> Gate time. Touches test files and possibly hot production code paths only for bit-identical speed-ups.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- scripts/gate-time.sh GUT Time is at least 10 s lower than the measured before figure (two runs reported), with the same test count and every test passing.
- scripts/check-test-leaks.sh is clean.
- tests/README.md has the before / after row and the Phase 10 allotment line (t2 1.5, t3 0.8, t4 2.0, t5 2.5, t6 2.0, t7 2.0, t8 2.5, t9 0.3, t10 0.8, t11 3.5, t12 2.5, t13 0).
- If 10 s cannot be found without breaking a rule, the run ends with Result: ESCALATE and the profile.
